B019MGTHFQ.Description: Overview: The HDMI cable is the newest and best digital video connection on the market. Specifications: • Our High Speed HDMI cables</> - with Ethernet have been designed to meet the performance standards. They are backward compatible to all previous versions. • HDMI Ethernet Channel</> - The HDMI cable adds a data channel to the HDMI connection, enabling high-speed, bi-directional communication. Connected devices that include this feature can send and receive data via 100 Mb/sec Ethernet, making them instantly ready for any IP-based application. • Audio Return Channel</> - The new specification adds an audio channel that will reduce the number of cables required to deliver audio ""upstream"" from a TV to an A/V receiver for processing and playback. In cases where a TV features an internal content source, such as a built-in tuner or DVD player, the Audio Return Channel allows the TV to send audio data upstream to the A/V receiver via the HDMI cable, eliminating the need for an extra cable. • 3D Support</> - The version of the specification defines common 3D formats and resolutions for HDMI-enabled devices, enabling 3D gaming and other 3D video applications. • 4K Resolution Support</> - The new specification enables HDMI devices to support extremely high HD resolutions, effectively four times the resolution of a 1080p device. GET MORE VEGGIES! Thousand Lakes freeze dried peas are a terrific way to get more vegetables into your daily diet. Freeze dried peas are a convenient way to have peas on hand and ready to use in soup, dip, smoothies, or in salads as a healthy garnish.

STAYS FRESH! Freeze drying is the best way to preserve fresh fruits and vegetables by drying them without using heat. Freeze dried products are "ready to eat" - they can be eaten as they are directly out of the package as a snack on their own or added to smoothies, cereal, trail mix, salads, or other delicious foods. Air dried ("dehydrated") foods are dried using heat - but not cooked - and often not labeled as "ready to eat" should be cooked before being consumed.

100% NATURAL – All of our freeze dried products have only one ingredient - no additives, preservatives, or artificial flavors. Our freeze-dried products are naturally gluten free but we do not independently test for possible gluten cross contamination. Therefore, we do not label our products gluten free. Harvested from ancient sugar maple trees and hand crafted using traditional, artisanal health spout taps, our syrup is a pantry staple.

GRADE A DARK COLOR AND ROBUST FLAVOR: With a deep hue and robust maple flavors, this versatile Grade A syrup is great as a topping and for cooking. Its strong maple flavor also lends itself to meat glazes, grill marinades, and on top of waffles, pancakes, and oatmeal.

RESPONSIBLY SOURCED: Coombs Family Farms has produced organic, great tasting maple syrup for seven generations. We farm our own land, produce 100% organic maple syrup and package our own pure maple products. Coombs also sources maple syrup from over 3,000 small independent family farms that share our commitment to quality, environmental stewardship, and sustainable forest management.

“A NATURAL FOOD”: This 100% organic Vermont maple syrup is harvested from pesticide free farms. Containing no artificial flavors, preservatives, or dyes, this Grade A syrup is non-GMO, gluten-free, nut-free, and Kosher Certified.

item.Description: Here at Ocean Spray we like cranberries. We really, really like cranberries. We probably know cranberries better than anyone. But the funny thing is most people don't know that much about them. We'd like to change that. Cranberries are actually one of the most unique fruits in the world. In fact, it's only one of three fruits that are native to North America. They are a wild fruit that grow on long-running vines in sandy bogs and marshes. Mostly in the northeast, but also in other parts of North America, like Wisconsin and the Pacific Northwest. It was Native Americans who first took advantage of cranberries. They mixed deer meat and mashed cranberries to make pemmicana-survival food. They also believed in the medicinal value of cranberries--long before science discovered the cranberry's beneficial properties!

item.Description: Flashpoint 19" AC Powered 55W 5500K Dimmable LED Light Ring Take the cool continuous power of LED light, blend it with the soft, shadowless caress of a ring light, add a 19" diameter of 5500K and you have the formula for great results for video and still photography when the subject demands a beauty light solution. The Flashpoint 19" AC Powered 55W 5500K Dimmable LED Light Ring is a lightweight, portable ring of light that delivers all of the above. The adjustable dimmer allows you to vary the light intensity from 10-100% to allow for precise balancing with available daylight lighting and finding the right touch without repositioning. This light ring uses little power and produces very low heat, allowing for closer subject proximity and keeps the model's comfort and make-up just right. The ring fits atop a standard light stand and can be tilted to any angle. The light ring produces flattering beauty quality, and it is a favorite among fashion, children photographers and journalists, creating signature catchlights in the eyes. Macro photographer prefer it, too, for the soft envelope of illumination that seems to fill every hard to reach place. The radiance is soft and virtually free of shadows, but softer effects can be reached by the separately available diffusion 'sock'. The optional snap on Flashpoint 19" filters set (FPRLX001) includes diffusion and color gels for balancing with tungsten or adding warmth to lighting. Speaking of options

Factor lights are ready to go for right out of the box; no extra diffusion or accessories needed and create a strong; diffuse light with no hotspots with a single; soft; clean shadow and a CRI ?96 making them great for photo or video shoots. FACTOR lights are also flicker-free making them a great option for any shooting scenario; including slow motion video.The FACTOR Radius Pico is a powerful and lightweight lighting solution for those times when you’re on the go. item.Description: The new Toshiba W727 is the company's top-of-the-line 4-head VHS hi-fi stereo VCR. What sets this deck apart from the rest of the Toshiba lineup is its VCR Plus+ C3 capability. This enhanced version of VCR Plus+ not only lets you do basic TV programming, but it also controls your cable box with ease. You no longer need an engineering degree to tape your favorite cable shows--VCR Plus+ C3 does it for you. Along with this great feature, the W727 features the company's revolutionary V3 chassis, with a unique flying preamp design for superior audio and video performance. Toshiba also combined the V3 chassis and flying preamp design with an additional pair of 19-micron heads to deliver sharper, clearer pictures in the extended play (EP) mode. With its hi-fi stereo sound, prerecorded tapes with stereo soundtracks sound almost as good as CDs. As a bonus, the W727 includes a universal remote control. And, to make transferring camcorder footage to VHS tapes as simple as possible, the W727 has convenient front A/V inputs for quick connections. You can even connect a video game system. The Toshiba W727 offers one-touch recording, commercial skip (so you can fast-forward past annoying ads), and one-minute rewind for T-120 cassettes. All Toshiba VCRs are designed to make recording and playback fast and hassle-free. The W727 has a special onscreen programming system with visual icons that guide you through every step of the recording process with point-and-click simplicity, as well as providing recording capability for six programs a month. Other features include digital auto tracking and auto setup for a painless out-of-the-box experience.

item.Description: Instruction:   1. Comb or brush it by special wig comb.  2. Care solution for hair is recommended when ruffled.  3. Wash it every 3 to 7 days. Comb it before putting into water, soak it for 15 minutes with hair conditioner, then rinse it with clear water. Dry it by towel and put it onto wig bracket. It can be used when 90% dryness. It is better to spray 3 to 5 times of care solution before use.  4. Divide long wig into 3 sections, comb it downward from bottom, then from the middle and finally from the top. Curl the wig along with the original curl after washing.  5. You can finger style or use a wig pick or brush to style it. Hair spray can also be used. The Korean high-temp synthetic fiber can be style, heated, set in curlers or flat irons.  6. It can not be dyed. Please turn to a hair designer for help when trimming the wig. Cleaning Instruction:  1. Comb the wig, notes: if it is a long wig, please comb it from ponytail to top 2. Put the wig in cold or warm water for 5 to 10 minutes, NOT hot water.Time can't be too long, or hair is easy to fall off 3. Use clear water to clean, Hand wash, Pleaes DON'T use the washing machine 4. Choose wig shampoo, avoid scrub, Gently grasp the wig with hands 5. Wipe the water with dry towel, Please DON'T screwed by hand or by a washing machine to dry 6. Put a airy place, avoid by drying in sunshine  How to collection:   1.If you don't wear the wig temporarily, please spray some nursing liquid and put on mannequin head 2.If you don't wear for a long time, please set the wig with a hairnet after spray nursing liquid and put into a bag with small round holes 3. Keep in a dry place, avoid pressure

item.Description: Here at Ocean Spray we like cranberries. We really, really like cranberries. We probably know cranberries better than anyone. But the funny thing is most people don't know that much about them. We'd like to change that. Cranberries are actually one of the most unique fruits in the world. In fact, it's only one of three fruits that are native to North America. They are a wild fruit that grow on long-running vines in sandy bogs and marshes. Mostly in the northeast, but also in other parts of North America, like Wisconsin and the Pacific Northwest. It was Native Americans who first took advantage of cranberries. They mixed deer meat and mashed cranberries to make pemmicana-survival food. They also believed in the medicinal value of cranberries--long before science discovered the cranberry's beneficial properties!

item.Description: Ancient wisdom The practice of tongue cleaning dates back to ancient times in India, but its benefits – especially the promotion of fresh breath and oral hygiene – have recently gained a lot of attention in the West. Regular tongue scraping has been shown to prevent bad breath, dental decay as well as enhance the sense of taste. Increasingly being recognized by dentists and healthcare professionals, regular tongue cleaning is a healthy habit to implement in one’s daily oral care routine and an effective treatment for bad breath. Why copper? Ayurveda’s medicinal texts mention tongue scrapers being made from pure, unalloyed metals, such as gold, silver, copper or tin. Thanks to modern science we now know that copper is the ideal metal for this purpose. Copper as a metal has been known for its medicinal purposes for centuries. Even in ancient times, copper was recognized as a source of minerals and a cleansing agent. Copper tongue scrapers are far more effective than plastic scrapers or other metal scrapers because of copper's inherent oligodynamic property. Instructions: 1. Use daily, early in the morning, ideally on an empty stomach. 2. Hold the two ends in both hands. 3. Extend the tongue and place the tongue cleaner on the surface of the tongue, as far back as is comfortable. 4. Gently pull the tongue cleaner forward so that it removes the unwanted coating of plaque. 5. Rinse the tongue cleaner and repeat as necessary, 7-14 times. item.Description: Turn brushing teeth with your child into a positive experience after every meal and at bedtime with Baby Buddy's Brilliant Baby Toothbrush of the Brilliant Oral Care System. The program guides you with innovative oral care products that grow with your child from birth. Starting from the Foundations and through Teething & Budding, the products are designed to take care of budding baby teeth with state of the art and soft products that children love to chew on. During Teeth Eruption & Development, the program progresses to distinctive toothbrushes for ages 4 months to 5 years that easily clean those hard-to-reach places where food and plaque can build up and cause cavities and other oral problems. The Brilliant Toothbrush revolutionizes the industry with its innovative design featuring bristles 360˚ around the toothbrush head that are devised specifically for your child's tender teeth and gums. Over 10,000 short but highly elastic bristles gently massage gums and effectively clean the cheek and gums. And because of its unique design, brushing is always at a 45 degree angle, allowing parents and caretakers to brush teeth, tongue, and gums without needing to twist their wrist. This unique patented design can be used with water only to clean teeth to help remove plaque and sugar buildup that typically causes tooth decay. Developed in partnership with the Osaka University Infant Dental Clinic, the Brilliant Toothbrush effectively removes almost twice as much plaque as conventional, one-sided toothbrushes, when brushing for 2 minutes. The Brilliant Baby Toothbrush has been sized with a 4-24 month old in mind. Give your child the gift of a lifetime of good oral care habits with the innovative Brilliant Toothbrush. Pro Tip: Do this in between two mirrors so that you can see your crown from all possible angles.  Step 3: Select Your Preferred Base Type Silk Base: Maybe 2 or more lace layers, The knots are perfectly hidden, so you're free to sport whatever hairstyle you like; Monofilament Base: Made of one layer lace, it looks so natural, every strand of hair is hand-tied to the soft, fine mesh material on top of the base. Rose Base: Machine made base, Usually cannot be parted, looks unnatural  Step 4: Decide on Your Hairstyle When choosing a hairstyle, consider the length and shape of your hair topper.   How long will my wig last? A lot will depend on the environment that you wear it in. As a general rule of thumb: Fibre hairpieces: This type of hair topper can last from 4 months to 9 months depending on various factors such as hair length, quality and maintenance. Human Hair hairpieces: This type of topper can last for up to 1 year or even longer - depending on various factors such as quality, construction and maintenance.   It is not recommended to sleep in hairpiece, it will cut the lifespan of the hairpiece in half. However, we understand this is not always possible so if you do, sleeping on a silk pillow is advised.

item.Description: Sucraneige or Sucre Neige is preferred by French chefs and bakers: unlike confectioner's sugar it will not melt or disappear on top of cakes, cookies or other baked goods even when they are warm from the oven or refrigerated under plastic wrap. Also known as Snow Sugar, it is finely powdered and looks evenly, perfectly sprinkled on top of icing, whipped cream or fresh, warm donuts and muffins. Sucre Neige is a superior topping; a dusting is the perfect way to finish off your favorite chocolate cake or batch of cookies and it will be unaffected by temperature or moisture. Sucraneige was especially developed to remain picture perfect without dissolving and to maintain its pristine, crisp white color. It tastes less sweet regular confectioner's sugar or icing sugar, which primarily contain glucose powder with a touch of cornstarch. Snow sugar can be used to decorate any type of dessert, but it is particularly effective for use on moist baked goods. For example, it will look beautiful on lemon bars and fruit tarts without having to be refreshed. It can also be sprinkled on top of ice cream without melting. It is a superior product: the PatisFrance Sucraneige is a sought-after ingredient by European bakers for its consistent performance..

BulletPoints: The MC is Aputure's first light to include full Hue, Saturation, & Intensity (HSI) color control. With 360° of hue and 100 levels of saturation adjustment, you have the power to conveniently reproduce any color, all in the palm of your hand.

The MC prides itself in its color rendition, with CRI and TLCI scores of 96+, and SSI scores of 84 in tungsten and 74 in daylight.RGBWW:By adding two additional white LEDs — one balanced at tungsten and a second at daylight.

In the MC's FX mode, toggle between any of the MC’s nine built-in lighting effects presets to help you out in a pinch. If you need more control over your lighting effects, the Sidus Link app will allow you to adjust all of the effects’ parameters. Lighting effects include: Paparazzi, Fireworks, Faulty bulb, Lightning, TV, Pulsing, Fire, Party, Cop Car.

The Sidus Mesh technology built into the MC allows you to control up to 100 lights in a stable network simultaneously via the Sidus Link mobile app.Sidus Link allows for finer control of the light's HSI, CCT, and FX functions by enabling additional control methods and parameters.

The MC is compatible with the Qi wireless charging protocol, enabling it to be used with the majority of the wireless chargers on the market. Simply place it on a wireless charging pad and the MC will be ready when you need it.

item.Description: Most commonly known as Hungarian Nut Rolls, Kolachi or Strudels, this is a popular European Sweet Bread Wrap filled with a variety of delicious fillings. Just like Barbara's Great Grandmother's Butter Cookie recipe, our Nut (mostly walnuts & cinnamon), Danish Cheese, PoppySeed & Apricot Wrap 'n Rolls re-create an old world pastry made with the same artisan ingredients & care of long ago. We've even added a modern-day variety with our Nutella & Cheese variety. Nut Rolls are traditional rolled pastry logs of tender, delectable sweet bread that wraps a variety of sweet, rich or creamy fillings before baking. We are committed to baking and delivering the highest quality fresh baked goods. We take the extra time and care to bake Nut Rolls the old-fashioned way with fresh ingredients such as sugar, flour, eggs, milk & butter. We do not use artificial ingredients, additives, fillers or preservatives. We like them best when served warm right out of the oven, dusted with powdered sugar. Bob's Red Mill Natural Foods is an Oregon-based company that utilizes simple, old-world technology to mill hundreds of all-natural whole grain products. Bob's Red Mill is dedicated to the manufacturing of natural foods in the natural way. In their own words: "With all the sophisticated knowledge of recent times, no machinery has yet been developed that grinds grains into flour quite as well as our flint-hard quartz millstones quarried in France and used by discriminating millers since early Roman times." "Our well-dressed (sharpened) sets of millstones turn the highest quality wheat into a finer, better baking bread flour than all the hammer mills, steel roller mills, steel buhr mills, or pulverizers ever built! These slow turning millstones grind the bran, endosperm, and germ (containing its nutritious wheat germ oil) into flour in a cool natural way, creating a more assimilable food." Bob's Red Mill stone grinds all common and most uncommon grains into flours and meals on its over 100-year-old mills. They mix them into an astounding array of unique cereals, pancake and waffle mixes, machine and hand-made bread mixes, quick bread mixes, gluten-free mixes, and specialty grain products.

item.Description: WHY YOU NEED THEM The problem with most tactical pants is that they "look" like tactical pants. Even the "tactical jeans" on the market today scream "look at me...I'm that tactical dude." What you need is a pair of pants that are low key (actually look like normal jeans) and allow you to carry your EDC load-out in a low-vis manner. Couple this with a pair of jeans that are sleek and stylish (so you actually look like you know a thing or two about fashion) and you have The 221B Asset Jeans: The tactical pants that your lady won't yell at you for wearing out to dinner. We live in a crazy world...and it's getting crazier. You need to be ready no matter where you are or what you're doing. Whether you’re wearing a t-shirt and sandals, a button-down and shoes, or a hoodie and boots, you want and need a pair of jeans that not only fit and look great, but also allow you to have everything you need on your person so you're ready for any situation...without letting the rest of the world know. HOW THEY WORK The Asset Jeans were designed like no other tactical pants on the market today. With 13 strategically placed pockets and holders, The Asset Jeans offer a level of utility and versatility never before seen in a pair of tactical pants. In addition to the 5 pockets traditionally found on jeans, The Asset Jeans offer 8 additional pockets to secure everything from large cell phones, wallets, pistol and rifle mags, EDC items and even a CCW when in a pinch. The Asset Jeans also feature the latest in stretch denim technology. Couple that with a gusseted crotch (for superior range of motion and man-spreading), tactical-stretch pocket linings and a strategic, comfort-stretch yoke (prevents plumbers crack) and you have yourself a pair of the best and most comfortable tactical pants.

item.Description: Very clean, fresh vanilla with a sweet underlying vanilla bean perfume. It is soft-textured and brings about a soft -creamy backdrop onto your palate. Unlike a basic vanilla extract or flavoring, this has an overall gentle elegance. In beverages like coffee and tea  this flavoring will smooth off the the bight or acidity of coffees and teas (or alcohol-based drinks). In all applications this will provide a soft rich background flavor. BulletPoints: The GPD Win 3 is the latest iteration of the GPD Win series of handheld gaming PCs to hit the market – from the manufacturers of the popular GPD Win, GPD Win 2, GPD XD and more, GPD bring their numerous years of experience to light in this premium AAA gaming computer that fits in the palm of your hand.

Powered by an impressive 11th generation Intel Core i1165G7 CPU, cutting-edge 12th generation Iris Xe graphics, and 16GB of blazing fast LPDDR4x RAM, and a 1TB NVMe SSD, the GPD Win 3 will easily run video games from all generations, both new and old.

Size-wise, the GPD is approximately only 198x92x27mm, making it a portable handheld gaming computer that is like the Nintendo Switch in form-factor. The 5.5 inch IPS screen with a 1280x720p resolution, rated at 268 pixels-per-inch also allows for crisp visuals in all your games.

Need something more in-line with a desktop computer? The GPD Win 3 can be docked using the Thunderbolt 4 port in the bottom of the device, allowing you to connect multiple peripherals such as keyboards, mice, full-size monitors, RJ45 cables, and more!
With the power of Thunderbolt 4, you can even dock the GPD Win 3 with an external graphics card using eGFX technology, drastically improving your performance in games. (External GPU not included)

item.Description: With a sturdy, lightweight zig-zag sole, the new voss women's sandal by Dr. Martens has tons of classic doc's durability and tough attitude in an edgy-yet-comfortable wedge platform style.  Dr. Martens is the stuff of legends. It all began near Munich, Germany in 1945 when Dr. Klaus Maertens injured his foot in a skiing accident in the Bavarian Alps. To make walking easier during the healing process, he designed a shoe with an air-cushioned sole. Using old rubber tires, he constructed soles that had air trapped within closed compartments. He showed his prototype to his engineer/inventor friend, Dr. Herbert Funck, and together they decided to develop and produce the shoes. Not only did the shoe solve the doctor's immediate problem, but it also started to sell well in Germany. By 1959 the two decided that they needed a company to produce and distribute the shoes, then called Dr. Maertens, in other parts of the world. At first, many manufacturers rejected the concept of an air cushioned sole as a short-lived gimmick. However, the R. Griggs Group, located in the village of Wollaston in England, decided to go along with the idea by creating the first work boot with the revolutionary sole. On the first of April 1960, the first cherry red eight-eyelet work boot was produced and named 1460. To sell the brand name better in England, the name was anglicized to Dr. Martens. The range was branded AirWair and the rest is history.

BulletPoints: Our UST ALR screen material is the best choice of the UST laser projector, it is with special optical sawtooth structure and the light- rejecting filter to give a stunning performance in ambient light. Images are reproduced without the hot- spotting of other screens that rely on high gain to overcome ambient light. Also, it has no light-reflection.
This technology involves a triangular, black, horizontal lenticular structure, which is coated with reflecting material on the side facing the UST projector.
The screen is exclusively for table- mounted- short throw projectors. If you need to install the projector mounted in the ceiling, you can turn the screen upside down easily.
The black topside of the reflector absorbs ambient light from above, while light from the projector is reflected or diffused by the white coating and sent towards the audience.
Best image contrast is achiecved when the projector is below the screen and the reflector is pointing downwards.

item.Description: Gusta Biscotti are crafted following a traditional recipe that has proven to delight many customers in Italy, where this delicacy is also known as “Cantucci”. Originally the Cantucci recipe consisted of flour, honey and eggs, baked twice and cut in the characteristic oblong shape. Subsequent variations brought more ingredients, including almonds, pistacchios, lemon, cranberries and of course dark chocolate. Today the almond recipe has become the de-facto “classic” Biscotti choice in Italy and the US. Biscotti are great with coffee, hot chocolate or a dessert wine to fully appreciate their consistency and taste. They will quickly become part of your daily routine! item.Description: When it comes to fruit juice drinks, nothing compares to Hawaiian Punch. Bursting with the bold taste of natural fruit juices and flavors, Hawaiian Punch has a fun, delicious taste that kids enjoy and that adults reach for to quench their thirst. Created in a converted garage in Fullerton, California in 1934, Hawaiian Punch was originally developed from ingredients shipped from Hawaii. In fact, that’s how we came up with the name. Convenient, delicious and always refreshing, it’s also low-calorie which makes it the perfect fruit drink when you want a blast of fruit flavor that you can feel good about! It goes great with snacks, easily packs into a lunch box or can be enjoyed all by itself. Although mainly known for its Original Fruity Juicy flavor, you can now also find it in other fun flavors like Polar Blast, Punch Lemon Berry Squeeze, Punch Orange Ocean, Punch Green Berry Rush, Berry Limeade Blast and many more. There’s a flavor for everyone. Hawaiian Punch is caffeine-free, carbonation-free, gluten-free and provides 100 percent of the daily value of vitamin C. Treat your family to the delicious taste of Hawaiian Punch and enjoy the wave of flavor with every sip!.

item.Description: Raspberry Lime Polar Seltzer, opposites attract to create an amazing seltzer flavor-ite. Sweet and tart are always right. Polar Seltzer Premium Sparkling Water. Tiny Bubbles: The sparkle sets us apart. We've been perfecting the process of making our signature bubbles, with their long-lasting carbonation and crispness, since 1882. The bubbles are created by carefully dissolving Co2 into water at high pressure and freezing temperatures without exposing the flavors to oxygen. Other people may add sodium or sweeteners to shortcut the road to quality – we do not. Natural Flavors: The taste of our seltzers is defined by the quality ingredients of the ingredients we used. Our approach is to use only the highest-quality, proprietary combinations of flavors and aromas for depth and complexity. These ingredients are extracted and distilled from natural sources (such as lemon peel, lime, mint, etc.) to create highly concentrated “essences”. Relying on copious amounts of these very precious oils, we never skimp when it comes to taste. Triple-Filtered & Locally Sourced Water: Our water is locally sourced and then triple-filtered with our state-of-the-art process to ensure a consistent and authentic Polar Seltzer taste. NO sodium, fluoride, or other funny business added. This is why Polar Seltzer makes for health smart hydration. Family Made Since 1882: Just water, zillions of tiny bubbles, and great taste. Our family has been crafting Polar Seltzer with these same ingredients since 1882. That’s 138 years to perfect what our great-great-grandfather called the world’s best-tasting bubble recipe. At Polar Beverages we work hard to keep things uncomplicated, refreshing and endlessly creative. Take a sip, and let us know.

item.Description: Madame Loulou is a leader in the production of gluten free confectionery mixes for breads and cakes. Our products are enjoyed in more than 35 countries and are used by distinguished restaurants, caterers and bakers that pride themselves on the quality of their offerings. And now we're making some of the specialized ingredients we use in our certified gluten free products available to demanding chefs and bakers like you. All of our products are certified gluten free to the highest possible standard of less than 5 parts per million, making them safe for consumption for people with celiac disease or other gluten allergies. Why does this product not use vanilla extract? Vanilla extract is not a naturally occurring substance. Instead it is created by combining alcohol and vanilla beans. No two vanilla extracts are alike, they use different types of alcohol and beans of different quality and freshness and some will also use solvents to boost the amount of vanilla that is removed from the included pods. What is vanilla bean paste? Vanilla bean paste is a syrupy format for adding natural vanilla bean flavor to baking. The syrupy texture always comes from the sugar or glucose syrup (or other sugar sources) that are a part of it, while the actual vanilla flavor comes either from actual vanilla beans and pods or from vanilla extracts. Madame Loulou French Vanilla Flavoring Paste is made from real vanilla and provides bakers with a natural and cost effective choice for flavoring confectionery items and ice cream bases without having to worry about the presence of alcohol or solvents like propylene glycol that may be in other pastes made from vanilla extract. We add natural food colorings to ensure that our paste doesn't just enhance the taste of your creations but also lends a subtle and attractive color to them as well. French vanilla is a unique style of paste popularized in France and an essential part of our confectionery tradition.

item.Description: The 'Stollen' History 670 Years of ‘Stollen’ Tradition Probably the Saxonians invented it - the Christstollen, the King of all Christmas pastries. But this was a long time ago. For the first time, this cake was mentioned in 1330 in Naumburg/Saale, (Germany) as a special privilege granted to the bakers’ guild by the bishop. But probably its origin dates back to heathen pre-historic times. In the Middle Ages baking Stollen has developed into a highly regarded art. The growing significance in the 17th century was not only marginally connected with the activities of the East Indian Company, which in these times entertained a flourishing business with spices, which were also used for the preparation of Christstollen. For Christstollen all these exotic ingredients are still of decisive importance! They give it the very special taste and represent the characteristic feature of this pastry. The number of ‘Kölner Stollen’ made in the Rhine area represents a large share in Germany’s total Stollen production. The preparation of Stollen largely depends on the combination of the recipe. More over, much time is required for the preparation of Stollen dough, as they are heavy yeast dough containing large quantities of butter and margarine. In addition to selected flavours, spices, candied lemon and orange peel, almonds, nuts and raisins, quite often there is also added Marzipan to the dough. The preparation of a tasty Stollen that keeps well from such a heavy dough demands great professional skills of the baker. The traditional Stollen is the folded Stollen, and not the Stollen made in a baking pan. This fact reveals the actual skill of a Stollen baker, because the folded Stollen, possibly stuffed with Marzipan or Persipan, are more difficult to do.

item.Description: Raspberry Lime Polar Seltzer, opposites attract to create an amazing seltzer flavor-ite. Sweet and tart are always right. Polar Seltzer Premium Sparkling Water. Tiny Bubbles: The sparkle sets us apart. We've been perfecting the process of making our signature bubbles, with their long-lasting carbonation and crispness, since 1882. The bubbles are created by carefully dissolving Co2 into water at high pressure and freezing temperatures without exposing the flavors to oxygen. Other people may add sodium or sweeteners to shortcut the road to quality – we do not. Natural Flavors: The taste of our seltzers is defined by the quality ingredients of the ingredients we used. Our approach is to use only the highest-quality, proprietary combinations of flavors and aromas for depth and complexity. These ingredients are extracted and distilled from natural sources (such as lemon peel, lime, mint, etc.) to create highly concentrated “essences”. Relying on copious amounts of these very precious oils, we never skimp when it comes to taste. Triple-Filtered & Locally Sourced Water: Our water is locally sourced and then triple-filtered with our state-of-the-art process to ensure a consistent and authentic Polar Seltzer taste. NO sodium, fluoride, or other funny business added. This is why Polar Seltzer makes for health smart hydration. Family Made Since 1882: Just water, zillions of tiny bubbles, and great taste. Our family has been crafting Polar Seltzer with these same ingredients since 1882. That’s 138 years to perfect what our great-great-grandfather called the world’s best-tasting bubble recipe. At Polar Beverages we work hard to keep things uncomplicated, refreshing and endlessly creative. Take a sip, and let us know.

BulletPoints: HIGHLY PIGMENTED EYESHADOW BRONZE SHIMMER- Go for the bronze with our cream eyeshadow stick in shimmery honey-brown. With over 30 high-pigmented shades from Matte, Shimmer, and metallic, you can build your own eyeshadow palette and go as understated or bold as the day (or night) calls for.
CREME-TO-POWDER WATERPROOF EYESHADOW: This waterproof, crème-to-powder eyeshadow stick glides effortlessly across lids before drying to a waterproof crease-proof powder finish.

NATURALLY EFFECTIVE INGREDIENTS VITAMIN C & E: This cream-to-powder eyeshadow stick does double-duty, thanks to the hydrating, nourishing formula with vitamin C & E. Delicate sensitive skin will love the vitamin E that protects against free radicals with antioxidants, and the vitamin C, which treats environmental damage to improve skin tone and texture. And candelilla wax makes every shade easy to blend, naturally.
NO BRUSH REQUIRED: Just glide and go. With smooth application, a built-in smudger for effortless blending, and a waterproof powder finish, you don’t need a brush to get the look you love.

HOW TO APPLY: Prime the smudger by coating it with color, then sweep the eyeshadow stick directly across your eyelids. Use the built-in smudger or your fingers to blend before the formula sets. For best results, prime the smudger by coating it with color prior to use.

item.Description: Verjus is the tart, fresh juice of unripe wine grapes. It is a culinary ingredient indigenous to the world's wine producing regions that is used in sauce making, for poaching fish and meat, and to dress lettuces, vegetables and fruit. Verjus or verjuice as it is sometimes called, literally means green juice in the sense that it's made from fruit that has yet to fully ripen -it's green. It is used to add acidity to foods, an important component in food and in cooking. At Fusion, the Napa Valley Verjus is made from wine grapes removed from the vine in midsummer, at a point in the growing cycle called veraison; a stage at which red wine varieties such as Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot change in color from green to black and the berries begin to soften enough to press.As the grapes arrive at the winery, they are loaded into large pneumatic presses where the juice is gently extracted then transferred to refrigerated stainless steel tanks. The juice is allowed to settle for a couple of days, then it is lightly filtered and packaged. The fresh verjus is at its best right after pressing, and can be packaged immediately. This product must be refrigerated after it is opened. Last 4 weeks once opened.

item.Description: Most commonly known as Hungarian Nut Rolls, Kolachi or Strudels, this is a popular European Sweet Bread Wrap filled with a variety of delicious fillings. Just like Barbara's Great Grandmother's Butter Cookie recipe, our Nut (mostly walnuts & cinnamon), Danish Cheese, PoppySeed & Apricot Wrap 'n Rolls re-create an old world pastry made with the same artisan ingredients & care of long ago. We've even added a modern-day variety with our Nutella & Cheese variety. Nut Rolls are traditional rolled pastry logs of tender, delectable sweet bread that wraps a variety of sweet, rich or creamy fillings before baking. We are committed to baking and delivering the highest quality fresh baked goods. We take the extra time and care to bake Nut Rolls the old-fashioned way with fresh ingredients such as sugar, flour, eggs, milk & butter. We do not use artificial ingredients, additives, fillers or preservatives. We like them best when served warm right out of the oven, dusted with powdered sugar. Packaging: Comes shrink wrapped on a pad in shipping box. About 10"L x 4"W x 1.5"H. Over 1 lb. Gift wrapping includes a gift box, gift wrapping & ribbon. item.Description: Gusta Biscotti are crafted following a traditional recipe that has proven to delight many customers in Italy, where this delicacy is also known as “Cantucci”. Originally the Cantucci recipe consisted of flour, honey and eggs, baked twice and cut in the characteristic oblong shape. Subsequent variations brought more ingredients, including almonds, pistacchios, lemon, cranberries and of course dark chocolate. Today the almond recipe has become the de-facto “classic” Biscotti choice in Italy and the US. Biscotti are great with coffee, hot chocolate or a dessert wine to fully appreciate their consistency and taste. They will quickly become part of your daily routine! item.Description: Every slice is a celebration!   For over 65 years, the Olesen family has continued to use the traditional methods of Old Denmark to make our Kringle. Each Kringle takes 3 full days to make, resulting in 36 delicate layers for a truly flaky and flavorful pastry. Combine our scratch made fillings from the finest ingredients we can find, you are certain to find a flavor suited just for you. With thirteen delectable and award-winning flavors, you'll find a favorite for everyone on your list.   The Three Kringleteers  Enjoy three of our most traditional flavors. Pecan Kringle, our most requested flavor is always a great choice to serve at breakfast with coffee. Children and adults alike love our Apple Kringle, stuffed with crisp Michigan apples in a cinnamon sprinkled filling. We then finish this package with our Cream Cheesecake Kringle which is filled with velvety smooth, Wisconsin cream cheese filling. Perfect for breakfast, dessert or anytime in between.   Serving Instructions  Kringle is best served at room temperature or warmed in the oven. Remove the Kringle from the wax bag, remove plastic sheet and remove from plastic tray. If a warm Kringle is desired, place in a 350 degree oven for 3 1/2 minutes. Kringle can also be warmed in a microwave. When ready to serve, cut Kringle into 1 or 2 inch slices. Then watch for approving looks and gestures. For storage, Kringle freezes well. To thaw, let stand for 6 hours in room temperature or 12 hours in a refrigerator.

item.Description: When the temperature drops and there’s a chill in the air, wrap yourself up in the soft, warm comfort of this Dr. Relief Electric Heating Throw Blanket. Measuring 50” x 60” in size, this cozy micromink blanket will take that chill right out of your bones, warming you up in no time at all.  To provide long-term strength and use, this heating blanket is expertly crafted using 100% polyester. This durable fabric is abrasion-resistant to hold up to everyday wear and tear, allowing for continual use for years to come. It’s also machine-washable and dryer safe, coming out with no wrinkles so it looks as fresh and crisp coming out as it did going in.  Cuddle up on your sofa or couch to watch TV, or get cozy in your bed to read a good book. The heavenly soft microfiber material surrounds the thin, undetectable wires so you can enjoy optimal comfort no matter what you’re doing.  After plugging in the blanket, simply slide the on/off switch on the controller and press the temperature control key to select a low, medium or high heat setting. The level you select will be displayed and starts flashing as the blanket heats up. When it stops flashing, the blanket has reached a specific temperature and will begin to heat up again when the temperature drops to deliver consistent warmth for 4 hours.  As a safety precaution, this Dr. Relief Electric Heating Throw Blanket is equipped with an automatic shut-off feature after 4 hours.

BulletPoints: WHAT’S IN THE BOX: Our Deluxe Beard Dopp Kit includes what you need for on the go! The kit includes: (1) Zeus Beard Shampoo (8 fl oz), (1) Zeus Beard Conditioner (8 fl oz), (1) Zeus Beard Oil (1 fl oz), (1) 100% Soft Boar Bristle Beard Brush (G92), and (1) Zeus Dopp Bag (measures: 8”x8”x4”) to keep your essential tools organized and ready for your travels!

BEARD SHAMPOO: Our Zeus Beard Shampoo was specifically formulated for your beards. Created with mild natural ingredients, it provides you with a clean and healthy shine. The shampoo can be used daily without stripping your beard of its natural oils which helps prevent dryness and irritation. Unlike regular soaps, our shampoo contains ingredients like Dragon’s blood, Chamomile and Green Tea which aides with inflamed skin under your beards. Our beard shampoo is great for all types of skin!

BEARD CONDITIONER: The next step after our beard shampoo is our Beard Conditioner. Created to aide with dry and itchy skin beneath the beard and that awkward stage of beard growth, the beard conditioner was formulated with natural ingredients to tame even the bristliest beards and/or mustaches. To help soften and protect the hairs of your beard, our beard conditioner is blended with Pro-Vitamin B5, Aloe Vera and Avocado Oil. Like our shampoo, it aides with inflamed skin under your beard.

BEARD OIL: Our Beard Oil can be used in unison after our beard shampoo & conditioner. The beard oil is formulated with an exclusive antioxidant blend of Grapeseed Oil, Safflower Oil, Argan Oil and Vitamin E which moisturize and aides with healthy hair growth. It adds a slight shine to your dry facial hair without leaving you with the feeling of an oily and greasy feel on your face. Another positive with using our beard oil, it helps reduce beard itch while moisturizing both your hair and skin.

BOAR BRISTLE BRUSH (G92): The handle was created with European sourced Pear Wood with 100% second-cut Boar Bristle Hairs which provides the softness for the brush. The second-cut bristles are meant to be soft yet effective enough to attract and remove dirt from your beard while smoothing your facial hairs. The Pear Wood is top quality and won’t warp its life with you while the boar bristles are great for those with short beards, sensitive skin, or thinner type facial hair

item.Description: Turn brushing teeth with your child into a positive experience after every meal and at bedtime with Baby Buddy's Brilliant Baby Toothbrush of the Brilliant Oral Care System. The program guides you with innovative oral care products that grow with your child from birth. Starting from the Foundations and through Teething & Budding, the products are designed to take care of budding baby teeth with state of the art and soft products that children love to chew on. During Teeth Eruption & Development, the program progresses to distinctive toothbrushes for ages 4 months to 5 years that easily clean those hard-to-reach places where food and plaque can build up and cause cavities and other oral problems. The Brilliant Toothbrush revolutionizes the industry with its innovative design featuring bristles 360˚ around the toothbrush head that are devised specifically for your child's tender teeth and gums. Over 10,000 short but highly elastic bristles gently massage gums and effectively clean the cheek and gums. And because of its unique design, brushing is always at a 45 degree angle, allowing parents and caretakers to brush teeth, tongue, and gums without needing to twist their wrist. This unique patented design can be used with water only to clean teeth to help remove plaque and sugar buildup that typically causes tooth decay. Developed in partnership with the Osaka University Infant Dental Clinic, the Brilliant Toothbrush effectively removes almost twice as much plaque as conventional, one-sided toothbrushes, when brushing for 2 minutes. The Brilliant Baby Toothbrush has been sized with a 4-24 month old in mind. Give your child the gift of a lifetime of good oral care habits with the innovative Brilliant Toothbrush. Verjus is the tart, fresh juice of unripe wine grapes. It is a culinary ingredient indigenous to the world's wine producing regions that is used in sauce making, for poaching fish and meat, and to dress lettuces, vegetables and fruit.Verjus or verjuice as it is sometimes called, literally means green juice in the sense that it's made from fruit that has yet to fully ripen -it's green. It is used to add acidity to foods, an important component in food and in cooking.
Use in cocktails, mustard sauces, marinades, dressings, reduction sauces and risotto. It’s a great substitute for citrus juices. It is mild and has a slightly sweet taste.
item.Description: Verjus is the tart, fresh juice of unripe wine grapes. It is a culinary ingredient indigenous to the world's wine producing regions that is used in sauce making, for poaching fish and meat, and to dress lettuces, vegetables and fruit. Verjus or verjuice as it is sometimes called, literally means green juice in the sense that it's made from fruit that has yet to fully ripen -it's green. It is used to add acidity to foods, an important component in food and in cooking. At Fusion, the Napa Valley Verjus is made from wine grapes removed from the vine in midsummer, at a point in the growing cycle called veraison; a stage at which red wine varieties such as Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot change in color from green to black and the berries begin to soften enough to press.As the grapes arrive at the winery, they are loaded into large pneumatic presses where the juice is gently extracted then transferred to refrigerated stainless steel tanks. The juice is allowed to settle for a couple of days, then it is lightly filtered and packaged. The fresh verjus is at its best right after pressing, and can be packaged immediately. This product must be refrigerated after it is opened. Last 4 weeks once opened.

Verjus is the tart, fresh juice of unripe wine grapes. It is a culinary ingredient indigenous to the world's wine producing regions that is used in sauce making, for poaching fish and meat, and to dress lettuces, vegetables and fruit.Verjus or verjuice as it is sometimes called, literally means green juice in the sense that it's made from fruit that has yet to fully ripen -it's green. It is used to add acidity to foods, an important component in food and in cooking.
Use in cocktails, mustard sauces, marinades, dressings, reduction sauces and risotto. It’s a great substitute for citrus juices. It is mild and has a slightly sweet taste.

item.Description: French Vanilla Crème: Very clean fresh vanilla with a sweet aroma and soft texture that brings about a creamy custard backdrop onto your palette. Not an ordinary vanilla because of its dainty perfumes and flavors that will accent your coffees/teas and seltzer with finesse. In cookie mixes, frostings, batters, doughs and cake mixes, use the same proportions as Vanilla Extract. Custard Crème: Our most versatile flavor and a great secret ingredient that almost deserves the term "voluptuous" and it “creamifies” any other of our flavors that you blend this into. It has a complex set of perfumes of freshly beaten brown sugar, vanilla bean, eggs and rich cream. Custard Crème shows off a taste that is kind of like the spoonful of cookie dough that you sniff and steal from the bowl when baking. Chocolate (Milk Chocolate): With this newest recipe, we have finally bottled up a really clean classical milk chocolate. Stirred into a glass of milk itself, it will create sensations of old fashioned chocolate milk. Even though it is unsweetened, it has gourmet-quality melted and frothy aromas, plus the right frothy/melty chocolate in the body of the flavor that a lot of people crave but “need to avoid”. Rich Dark Chocolate: Warm aromas of a deep dark chocolate bar. Unlike dark cocoa or chocolate, this has the pleasantly deeper darker melted chocolate flavor without bitterness. This dark chocolate plays well when blended with the Toasted Almonds and Banana Foster. This Rich Dark Chocolate is the perfect background flavoring when you want to add a clean-tasting darker chocolate background dimension to your beverages and your creative food recipes. Caramel Crème Brulee: Melted caramel and sweet cream custard aromas and flavors without any sugars (add your own). This is a dainty but seductively rich set of flavors. It can nicely add complexity and pleasing background flavors to any coffee, oatmeal, chocolate chip recipe, muffin mix.

item.Description: Ancient wisdom The practice of tongue cleaning dates back to ancient times in India, but its benefits – especially the promotion of fresh breath and oral hygiene – have recently gained a lot of attention in the West. Regular tongue scraping has been shown to prevent bad breath, dental decay as well as enhance the sense of taste. Increasingly being recognized by dentists and healthcare professionals, regular tongue cleaning is a healthy habit to implement in one’s daily oral care routine and an effective treatment for bad breath. Why copper? Ayurveda’s medicinal texts mention tongue scrapers being made from pure, unalloyed metals, such as gold, silver, copper or tin. Thanks to modern science we now know that copper is the ideal metal for this purpose. Copper as a metal has been known for its medicinal purposes for centuries. Even in ancient times, copper was recognized as a source of minerals and a cleansing agent. Copper tongue scrapers are far more effective than plastic scrapers or other metal scrapers because of copper's inherent oligodynamic property. Instructions: 1. Use daily, early in the morning, ideally on an empty stomach. 2. Hold the two ends in both hands. 3. Extend the tongue and place the tongue cleaner on the surface of the tongue, as far back as is comfortable. 4. Gently pull the tongue cleaner forward so that it removes the unwanted coating of plaque. 5. Rinse the tongue cleaner and repeat as necessary, 7-14 times. BulletPoints: WHAT’S IN THE BOX: Our Vegan Beard Set includes the following: (1) Zeus Beard Shampoo (8fl oz), (1) Zeus Beard Conditioner (8fl oz), (1) Zeus Refined Beard Oil (2fl oz), (1) Zeus Vegan Tampico Pocket Brush (N73) and our Zeus Tin to hold it all together.

BEARD SHAMPOO: Our Zeus Beard Shampoo was specifically formulated for your beards. Created with mild natural ingredients, it provides you with a clean and healthy shine. The shampoo can be used daily without stripping your beard of its natural oils which helps prevent dryness and irritation. Unlike regular soaps, our shampoo contains ingredients like Dragon’s blood, Chamomile and Green Tea which aides with inflamed skin under your beards. Our beard shampoo is great for all types of skin!

BEARD CONDITIONER: The next step after our beard shampoo is our Beard Conditioner. Created to aide with dry and itchy skin beneath the beard and that awkward stage of beard growth, the beard conditioner was formulated with natural ingredients to tame even the bristliest beards and/or mustaches. To help soften and protect the hairs of your beard, our beard conditioner is blended with Pro-Vitamin B5, Aloe Vera and Avocado Oil. Like our shampoo, it aides with inflamed skin under your beard.

REFINED BEARD OIL: For something to be refined, it must be free from impurities. Crafted from a unique blend of Sweet Almond, Soybean, Argan, and Avocado Oils, this beard oil stands as a pure moisturizing and leave-in conditioner for both hair and skin. This thicker gel-like beard oil is fast absorbing and provides you with an elasticity boosting and moisturized looking beard. Along with taking care of your hair, it also conditions and nourishes your skin. This is great for all types of beards.

VEGAN POCKET BEARD BRUSH (N73): This Pocket Beard Brush was created using all-natural materials like Walnut, which provides you with great durability and is warp resistance as its handle. The bristles are created with natural Tampico fibers which comes from a cactus type plant native to Mexico making this beard brush all-natural and Vegan friendly. The leaves are harvested before fibers are extracted, dried, undyed, and cut to desired length to form a medium-firm bristle for our brush.

item.Description: French Vanilla Crème: Very clean fresh vanilla with a sweet aroma and soft texture that brings about a creamy custard backdrop onto your palette. Not an ordinary vanilla because of its dainty perfumes and flavors that will accent your coffees/teas and seltzer with finesse. In cookie mixes, frostings, batters, doughs and cake mixes, use the same proportions as Vanilla Extract. Custard Crème: Our most versatile flavor and a great secret ingredient that almost deserves the term "voluptuous" and it “creamifies” any other of our flavors that you blend this into. It has a complex set of perfumes of freshly beaten brown sugar, vanilla bean, eggs and rich cream. Custard Crème shows off a taste that is kind of like the spoonful of cookie dough that you sniff and steal from the bowl when baking. Chocolate (Milk Chocolate): With this newest recipe, we have finally bottled up a really clean classical milk chocolate. Stirred into a glass of milk itself, it will create sensations of old fashioned chocolate milk. Even though it is unsweetened, it has gourmet-quality melted and frothy aromas, plus the right frothy/melty chocolate in the body of the flavor that a lot of people crave but “need to avoid”. Rich Dark Chocolate: Warm aromas of a deep dark chocolate bar. Unlike dark cocoa or chocolate, this has the pleasantly deeper darker melted chocolate flavor without bitterness. This dark chocolate plays well when blended with the Toasted Almonds and Banana Foster. This Rich Dark Chocolate is the perfect background flavoring when you want to add a clean-tasting darker chocolate background dimension to your beverages and your creative food recipes. Caramel Crème Brulee: Melted caramel and sweet cream custard aromas and flavors without any sugars (add your own). This is a dainty but seductively rich set of flavors. It can nicely add complexity and pleasing background flavors to any coffee, oatmeal, chocolate chip recipe, muffin mix.

item.Description: Florida's Natural Growers was organized in 1933 by growers who had a personal interest in bringing the best possible citrus products to the market. Today, we are one of the largest Florida citrus cooperatives of growers, with a membership base of 13 grower associations. The entire cooperative is made up of more than 1,000 grower-members who own more than 50,000 acres of fine citrus groves in the heart of central Florida. We own the land, and we personally nurture the fruit until it reaches peak ripeness. Because we process and package everything ourselves, we can guarantee the quality of our citrus juices. Citrus growing is a time-honored tradition in central Florida, one that has been passed down through generations. Our grower families came together through Florida's Natural Growers to ensure that the knowledge and lands our grandfathers passed down to us continue to thrive and to cultivate the juiciest, best tasting oranges you can get anywhere in the world. As a grower-owned operation, we believe it's important to know exactly where your family's food and drinks come from. BulletPoints: PROTECT YOUR HAIR. Effectively protect your hair from dryness, breakage, and unnecessary tangles in the morning. Using a silk bonnet for sleeping is crucial for any hair type. Our satin hair bonnet for women and men is made of a material that will protect your hair perfectly.

WEAR DAY AND NIGHT. This satin bonnet is the multipurpose solution that will help you maintain and protect your hair all day long. Great for curly hair while sleeping, cooking, running, gardening, shopping, or walking the dog. Great looking and feels good too!

PERFECT GIFT IDEA. Want to give the gift of beautiful hair and sweet dreams? Make that special someone happy with this beautiful satin hair bonnet. This satin sleep bonnet is sure to please! item.Description: Seymour AV's Glacier White is a perfect solution for those that want smaller or shorter screens or otherwise aren't interested in an acoustically transparent system, but still have good light control and dark colors. The Glacier White 1.3 non-AT solid screen is a multi-layer material that was developed keeping the easiest mounting method in mind, our grommet / o-ring system. The back side is a sturdy reinforced weave with an integrated black film to completely kill any translucence to the image, assuring that even in front of a white wall there will not be any contrast-killing light contamination like traditional non-reinforced vinyl screens have. On top of that is the optical layer with just enough sheen to provide gain and a light embossing to maximize uniformity and viewing angle. The Glacier White can handle 4K video resolutions, and can be used at any seating or projector throw distance. Like all white screens, the Glaicier White should be used in a room without ambient light and preferably darker colors. The Precision frame is 2.6" wide and covered in 99.5% light absorbing premium Baritone velvet to absorb the overscan. Featuring grommets around the screen border, you simply attach the screen to the frame using the provided stretchy bands onto pre-installed frame posts, making a trampoline that will always bounce back. The frame is split on the top and bottom and joined with 2.4 pounds of laser cut plated steel. Built in Iowa, Seymour AV screens are sold factory direct, worldwide and TO China.
